إنه التين الشوكي، الذي أُدخل إلى أستراليا كنبات للزينة، لكنه سرعان ما انتشر بشكل كارثي، حتى غطّى نحو 60 مليون فدان، مشكّلًا غابات كثيفة من الأشواك، وأجبر كثيرًا من المزارعين على هجر أراضيهم. حاول الأستراليون القضاء عليه بالحرق والاقتلاع والمواد الكيميائية، لكن دون جدوى؛ إذ كانت أجزاء صغيرة منه قادرة على النمو من جديد.

snippet.description:
Booth Level Officers (BLOs), many of whom are government school teachers, are increasingly dealing with multiple responsibilities. From census duties and Mid-Day Meal schemes to school-related administrative work and election responsibilities, their workload has become a growing concern.

The issue of work pressure on BLOs came into focus during a discussion on the demands of election-related duties. However, the response from the Election Commission offered a different perspective, raising questions about job responsibilities, accountability and the realities of government service.

BLOs play a crucial role in maintaining electoral rolls and ensuring the smooth functioning of the election process. But how much additional work can they reasonably be expected to handle alongside their regular duties?

Is the workload simply part of government service, or does the system need to rethink how election duties are assigned to BLOs?

snippet.title: बेटों ने माँ को घर से निकाला… 😢
snippet.description:
तीन बेटे की कहानी… बड़े बेटे ने माँ का थैला गेट के बाहर फेंक दिया, मँझले ने फ़ोन पे मना कर दिया। "कोना भी किराए का है, अम्मा।" और जो बेटा रोज़ चौक पे दिहाड़ी ढूँढता है, वो बोला: "आधी रोटी मेरी, आधी अम्मा की।"

फिर एक दिन अम्मा ने चुपचाप एक फ़ैसला लिया… कहानी आख़िर तक देखिए।

ये वीडियो उन्हें भेजिए जो अपनी माँ को साथ रखते हैं, और कमेंट में बताइए: आपके घर में माँ की दवाई कौन लाता है?

snippet.title: Lo que DESCUBRIERON de los ALCALDES de PUEBLA... y FALTAN MÁS | MLDA
snippet.description:
Adela Micha reporta la detención del alcalde de Atzitzintla, Eduardo Velázquez Medina, por sus vínculos con la banda Los Zúñiga dedicada al robo de autotransporte en la Sierra Negra de Puebla. Con esta captura ya suman seis servidores públicos detenidos, entre ellos tres presidentes municipales, en la Operación Enjambre.

La reportera Violeta García de Ultranoticias detalla cómo elementos de la Sedena, la Secretaría de Marina, la Fiscalía General de la República, la Guardia Nacional y la Agencia de Investigación Criminal ejecutaron el operativo de madrugada. Eduardo Velázquez enfrenta cargos por secuestro exprés y robo de vehículo agravado. Entre los alcaldes previamente detenidos están Urbiel González Vieira de Ciudad Serdán, Giovanni González Vieira de Tlachuca, Ramiro González Vieira de San Nicolás Buenos Aires, Gerardo Cortés Caballero de Cuauhtempan, y otros como Juan Pérez Moral, Zahid de Jesús Godos Luna y José Isaac Rodríguez Ochoa. Los delitos incluyen lavado de dinero, narcomenudeo, portación de arma de uso exclusivo del ejército, extorsión y enriquecimiento ilícito.

snippet.title: Cop Fires a Second Shot Into a Man on the Ground — Then Tells the Judge "No, Thank You"
snippet.description:
An Auburn, Washington police officer went to arrest a homeless man for disorderly conduct outside a grocery store. Sixty-seven seconds of struggle later, Jesse Sarey, 26, had been shot twice. At trial, the officer's lawyer told the jury, "You're going to hear from Officer Nelson." The defense rested without calling a single witness. A jury convicted Jeffrey Nelson of second-degree murder and first-degree assault, and the judge sentenced him to 200 months.

CHAPTERS

CASE
State of Washington v. Jeffrey Alan Nelson | King County Superior Court, Maleng Regional Justice Center, Kent, WA | No. 20-1-06432-3 KNT | Verdict June 27, 2024: guilty of second-degree murder (first shot) and first-degree assault (second shot) | Sentenced Jan. 23, 2025 by Judge Nicole Gaines Phelps to 200 months (123 months on the assault count, served at the same time). The state asked for 220 months; the defense asked for 78.
Nelson has appealed. As of this video, the Washington Court of Appeals has not ruled.

Սոնան հայտնվում է ընտանիքի անողոք ճնշման տակ, իսկ Լևոնին փորձում են համոզել, որ աղջիկն իրեն դավաճանել է Տիկոյի հետ: Դիտեք լարված այս սերիան և իմացեք, թե ով է իրականում կանգնած այս մեծ դավադրության հետևում:

"Hi. I'm here to sign up for a cop job." "You are in the right place. What drew you to law enforcement?" Yeah, this thing is from the 1970s." 😳 "Maybe he was just trying to impress his girlfriend." "By committing a felony?" 🚨 "Bad news, there's no cop in the LAPD with your boyfriend's name." "Well, if he's lying, why is his boss on your wall?" 👀 "Yeah, Captain Jennings." "Okay, well, that is problematic in a whole different way. Howard Jennings doesn't work here either. He retired eight years ago." 😱 So the detectives pay him a visit: "Think you can intimidate me with your little setup here?" "No, sir. You're a legendary tough guy who inspired loyalty in his men and fear in his enemies." "Who the hell are you to mock me?" "Your worst nightmare." 🔥 "Why cross over to the dark side?" "I have no idea what you're talking about, and I'm leaving." "And what crimes do you think these men have been doing?" "Well, robbing drug dealers so you can sell the product yourself." 💰 "We have Jeremiah and Marcus in custody, and they dropped your name the second the cuffs came out. It's over, sir.
